# Topbar Instructions

## Approved Behavior

- The topbar is visible at the top of the app.
- Background color is UST green: `#006e74`.
- The UST emblem appears at the top-left.
- The centered heading must read exactly `PACE PROFILE`.
- Do not add search, catalog tabs, profile menus, or extra controls unless the approved plan changes.

## Styling Expectations

- Keep the topbar compact and dashboard-oriented.
- The emblem must be readable against the green background.
- The title must stay visually centered even with the emblem on the left.
- Avoid decorative gradients or unrelated branding.
